name: Lobia Tomato Curry
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) black-eyed peas (lobia), soaked 6 hours
1 tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Pressure-cook the lobia with 1½ cups water for 3 whistles until tender.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the lobia with its liquid and simmer for 10 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.
note: Black-eyed peas cook faster than most beans and need only a short soak.
